meta.interpretation: Built a network linking each lead sponsor to the interventions in its KRAS-mutant non-small cell lung cancer trials.

visualization_rationale.reason: A network graph effectively visualizes the relationships between sponsors and drugs in KRAS-mutant non-small cell lung cancer trials, showing connections and collaborations.

assumptions: A lead sponsor is linked to a intervention when they appear in the same trial; edge weight is the number of such trials.
Only drug, biological and combination-product interventions are nodes; placebo and standard-of-care comparators are left out because they would link to everything.
Sponsor means the lead sponsor; collaborators are not counted.

plan.chart_rationale: A network graph effectively visualizes the relationships between sponsors and drugs in KRAS-mutant non-small cell lung cancer trials, showing connections and collaborations.
